universities.summary: MEASI Academy of Architecture is a private architecture institution established in 1999 at Royapettah, Chennai. Its current portfolio comprises B.Arch, M.Arch and M.Arch Real Estate Development. Design studios, model-making facilities and digital design resources form the academic setting.
universities.campusLifestyle: The academy occupies the MEASI/New College campus setting on Peters Road. Teaching spaces include design studios, lecture rooms, a model-making workshop, a materials museum and computer facilities. Library resources and the auditorium support study beyond the design studio.
universities.cityProfile: The campus is at Peters Road in Royapettah, Chennai. Its city-campus location makes the accommodation decision part of the shortlist: an available boys’ hostel place or another arrangement with a practical daily journey. Studio-based study also calls for planning how drawings, models and study materials will be carried and stored.
universities.practicalExposure: The B.Arch programme combines design studios with model making, computer-aided drawing and three-dimensional work. Site visits and professional training connect design exercises with built work. Facilities include materials, surveying and climatology resources, while digital design resources include AutoCAD, Revit and Rhino. These are academic learning provisions, not a guaranteed paid internship or job.
universities.hostelOverview: The 2026–27 provisional affiliation disclosure records an owned boys’ hostel inside the campus, with kitchen, dining and warden facilities. Current room availability and pricing are not established. Women’s accommodation is not confirmed in that disclosure and needs a separate housing plan.
universities.dietarySupport: The affiliation disclosure records a canteen and hostel kitchen/dining provision. It does not establish menus, special-diet arrangements or a current meal charge; food preferences belong in the accommodation and living-cost plan.
universities.safetyOverview: The academy maintains an anti-ragging committee, squad and flying squad. A grievance helpdesk accepts reports covering harassment, ragging and other concerns; the existence of these channels is not a personal-safety guarantee.
universities.studentSupport: The grievance helpdesk handles academic, examination, administrative, fee and infrastructure concerns from students and other campus stakeholders. Students Traffic can help compare the architecture entry route, aptitude-test evidence and housing plan before an application.

faq.question: Is this the same as other MEASI colleges?
faq.answer: No. This profile is for MEASI Academy of Architecture at Royapettah. Other MEASI institutions have separate awards and admission processes; their programmes are not included here.

faq.question: Which degrees does the academy offer?
faq.answer: The current portfolio lists B.Arch, M.Arch and M.Arch Real Estate Development. The detailed entry guidance here covers the B.Arch domestic counselling route; postgraduate selection and application requirements are separate.

faq.question: How long is the B.Arch programme?
faq.answer: The architecture degree lasts five academic years across ten semesters. The course includes design studios, technical study and professional training.

faq.question: What school subjects and marks are needed?
faq.answer: The 10+2 route needs Physics and Mathematics, an eligible additional subject and at least 45% aggregate. A 10+3 diploma with Mathematics and at least 45% aggregate is an alternative academic route.

faq.question: Is an architecture aptitude test required?
faq.answer: Yes. An eligible NATA or JEE Paper 2 architecture result is required in addition to the academic qualification. TNEA’s counselling process combines academic and aptitude performance for its ranking.

faq.question: How does the domestic counselling route work?
faq.answer: Applicants use the TNEA B.Arch registration and certificate-verification process before ranking and seat choices. This route has its own nativity, schooling and category rules; an eligible test score alone does not guarantee a seat.

faq.question: Can all overseas applicants use this route?
faq.answer: No. The verified TNEA B.Arch route permits specified Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO and Sri Lankan Tamil refugee categories under exact conditions. The OCI/PIO exception excludes those born abroad after 4 March 2021. A general foreign/NRI route is not established.

faq.question: Is a current tuition amount available?
faq.answer: Annual tuition is on request. The payment route requires the amount assigned to the applicant. Compare course charges separately from studio materials, accommodation and daily living rather than treating them as one confirmed package.

faq.question: What facilities support architectural study?
faq.answer: The academy identifies design studios, a model-making workshop, materials and surveying resources, a climatology laboratory, computer facilities and a library. Digital tools include AutoCAD, Revit and Rhino.

faq.question: Does the academy have a hostel?
faq.answer: Its provisional 2026–27 affiliation disclosure records an owned boys’ hostel inside campus. Current room rates and availability are not established, and women’s housing needs a separate arrangement review.

faq.question: What help is available with student concerns?
faq.answer: The grievance helpdesk covers academic, administrative and infrastructure matters as well as harassment or ragging reports. Students Traffic can help organize an application shortlist and practical study plan.

eligibleAudiences: Indian applicants meeting the TNEA 2026 B.Arch nationality/nativity/schooling rules
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders permitted by the stated exception
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees educated in Tamil Nadu with prescribed documents
restrictions: Only the positively evidenced TNEA B.Arch counselling route is covered, not general foreign or NRI admission.

Tamil Nadu candidates educated in Classes 8–12 within the state need no nativity certificate; Tamil Nadu natives who studied any of those classes outside it need the prescribed electronic nativity certificate.
Children of Central Government employees serving continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years need employer proof; a guardian qualifies only if both parents are deceased.
Children of permanent public-sector/government-recognised-institution employees serving in Tamil Nadu for five years need employer/employment evidence.
Children of Tamil Nadu-cadre All India Service officers need parental declaration; other-state applicants educated in Classes 8–12 in Tamil Nadu may apply.
Parent-service and other-state-schooling categories compete in Open Competition, not Tamil Nadu communal reservation.
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders compete in Open Category; the exception does not cover those born abroad after 4 March 2021.
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees educated in Tamil Nadu compete in Open Competition with the prescribed refugee evidence.
Academic qualification, single-board subject rules and accepted architecture aptitude qualification all remain mandatory; minimum eligibility does not assure a seat.
audienceEligibility.notes: Exact architecture-brochure rules, not transplanted engineering-subject conditions. No unverified nationality ban or unrestricted international availability is asserted.

admissionsContent.overview: The five-year architecture degree combines design studios with technical subjects, model making, digital drawing, site visits and professional training. Entry requires an eligible school or diploma qualification and an architecture aptitude test.

eligibility.intro: The B.Arch route requires both the academic qualification and an accepted architecture aptitude-test result.
items: Pass all subjects in 10+2 or equivalent from a single board, with Physics and Mathematics compulsory and at least 45% aggregate.
The third eligible subject can be Chemistry, Biology, a Technical Vocational subject, Computer Science, IT, Informatics Practices, Engineering Graphics or Business Studies.
Alternatively, pass a 10+3 diploma with Mathematics compulsory and at least 45% aggregate.
Qualify NATA or the accepted JEE Paper 2 architecture aptitude route. TNEA schooling, nativity and category rules also apply to its counselling seats.

applicationSteps: For the domestic counselling route, register through the TNEA B.Arch application process and enter academic and architecture aptitude-test details.
Upload original certificate copies and complete verification, then ranking and choice allotment. Ranking combines academic marks scaled to 200 and accepted NATA/JEE marks out of 200.
Follow the allotted institution’s reporting instructions; the college’s provisional-admission payment route requires an application number and the amount instructed.

academic: Qualifying NATA or accepted JEE Paper 2 architecture result
application: Applicable electronic Tamil Nadu nativity certificate or parent-employer/All India Service declaration evidence
Applicable Tamil Nadu community and special-reservation certificates
Income certificate and first-graduate certificate/joint declaration, when applicable
Government-school Classes 6–12 proof if claiming 7.5% reservation
OCI/PIO card and Tamil Nadu nativity evidence for that exception
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees: Headquarters Tahsildar identification certificate
Refugees not registered in a camp additionally need original passport, visa and police-station registration letter
Application number for the college provisional-admission payment route
